title: Whack a mole reflex game
when: The user wants a reflex game where moles pop out of holes for short moments and the player hits them for points before time runs out.
prompt:
Goal: A 30 second round that speeds up fairly, scores each hit once and works by tap or number keys.
Steps:
1. 3x3 grid of hole buttons; a mole shows in a random hole, never the same twice in a row.
2. logic.mjs: nextHole(prev, n, rand), hit(state, i) scoring only an up, unhit mole, upTime(elapsed) from 1000 ms to 450 ms, combo bonus.
3. Round time from timestamps; moles scheduled by a setTimeout chain cleared on stop.
4. Mole pops with a transform transition, a plain swap under prefers-reduced-motion.
5. aria-label "Hole 4, mole" or "Hole 4, empty"; keys 1 to 9 map to the grid like a number pad.
6. Score, time left and final result in aria-live; high score in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: no double hit, misses do not score, no repeat hole, upTime curve.
Quality bar:
- Hits register on pointerdown for speed.
- Holes large on phones.
- End screen shows hits and accuracy.
Pitfalls:
- Timers left running after the round.
- Score on a mole already going down.
- Hover only feedback.
Verify:
- [ ] Status live.
- [ ] Reduced motion rule present.
- [ ] Rules tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (rules), test.mjs.

examples.input: whack a mole game for a kids party
examples.output: 30 s round, 3x3 holes, speeds up, keys 1 to 9, high score
